title: faceto — event-sourced (comments become the log; the model is a projection)

elements.label: when a command succeeds, append the event to the log
when model-version changes, client swaps the SVG
when the log grows past threshold, compact
Who mints ids for added elements? (id is still identity)
Event schema versioning / migration over time
elements.detail: Schema grows by additive change (new optional fields ignored, new event kinds skipped on read = forward compat); a renamed event *kind* is migrated forward at events::upcast, the single read-path seam (backward compat), shape-detected so no version counter and no log-format change. Fields evolve additively only — a renamed field is indistinguishable from a new one by shape. A kind's meaning is never repurposed in place — add a new kind and upcast the old. Seeded with CommentAdded/Comment → ElementAnnotated.
elements.resolution: Additive-first + an upcast seam. Forward compat: unknown kinds/fields tolerated. Backward compat: a renamed kind is repaired in one place (upcast) before parse_event, shape-detected, zero churn to existing logs; fields evolve additively. Semantics never change in place.

elements.label: Concurrency: ordering of appends from multiple clients
Migration: fold the existing comments.jsonl into the log
elements.detail: faceto genesis folds a sibling comments.jsonl after the model's genesis batch: each stored comment maps through events::comment_to_events (the same mapping the live server uses) into ElementAnnotated/HotspotResolved/ElementRenamed/ElementMoved/ElementRemoved. Best-effort: blank/unparseable/elemId-less lines are skipped. The legacy inbox lands on the board instead of being stranded.
elements.resolution: Fold it into genesis. An old model.json + its comments.jsonl together become the start of a log — the batch mints the ids, the folded comments replay on top. comment_to_events is the single source of truth, shared with POST /comment.

elements.label: Replay cost: rebuild per request, or cache the projection?
elements.detail: cache the projection: version = fnv12(log bytes); reuse the existing ring keyed on the log hash; replay only on a cache miss; an in-memory snapshot caps replay length
elements.resolution: Cache the projection, keyed on the log's content hash. Extends serve.rs's existing rebuild-on-change + ring-cache idiom; replay runs only when a new event lands; snapshotting bounds replay cost.

elements.label: Is model.json a derived snapshot, or gone entirely?
elements.detail: log-only (pure ES): model.json is derived & gitignored, never hand-edited; the log is the only write path; render & serve replay the log; an existing model.json bootstraps as a genesis batch of ElementAdded events
elements.resolution: Gone entirely as a source of truth. event-log.jsonl is the only durable record and only write path; model.json becomes disposable derived output. You append events instead of editing a file.
